integrity: The rank-one Rota-Baxter defects are reconstructed symbolically from the defining identities. Every rank-at-most-one matrix over F_3 is checked directly, while finite-field component counts are independently replayed from determinantal formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the rank-at-most-one Rota-Baxter locus, not higher-rank operators.
Characteristic two is excluded because the binary bracket degenerates there.
The earliest source full-text HTML endpoint was inaccessible during this check; noncoverage was assessed from the later full same-object source and targeted literature searches.
title: Rank-one Rota–Baxter geometry of a four-dimensional Lie–Yamaguti example
